---
name: Access request
about: Ask for the read-only connection string to the meetings database
title: "Access request: <your name or organization>"
labels: access
---

Tell the maintainer, briefly:

- **Who you are** (name, and organization if any)
- **What you plan to do with the data** (a sentence is enough)
- **How to reach you privately** for the connection string (an email address, or say "reply here and I will email you"). The credential is never posted in the issue.

Access is read-only, free, and not gated on the purpose. The role can SELECT from the `meetings` schema and nothing else.
